script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling Solomon David’s son adds a fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The text does not say that nobody had trouble hearing Solomon.
The text does not say whether Solomon is reading anything. It says he blesses the assembly.
The coupon joke compares God’s promises to unreliable coupons, making the promises part of the joke.
The text says the altar was too small, not that it wasn’t worn out.
The comparison between the two stretches of land adds a geographical fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The text describes the people as joyful and glad; it does not establish that nobody felt sad.
